Ajnabee released on 21 September 2001. Twenty-five years today.

Abbas–Mustan's Switzerland-set thriller: two couples, an insurance plot and a murder charge. Akshay Kumar won Best Villain at the Filmfare Awards for it.
Bipasha Basu made her debut and won Best Female Debut.
It opened on Kareena Kapoor's 21st birthday, in her second year in films.
And it was an unofficial remake of the 1992 American thriller Consenting Adults.

Still know every Anu Malik track from it?

Deepika Padukone and Ranveer Singh have a second daughter.

The couple announced the birth on Saturday with a joint post: a baby footprint, dated 19/09/26, signed "Dua, Deepika and Ranveer".
Their first daughter, Dua, was born on 8 September 2024. The pregnancy was announced in April.
No name yet, and no photos of the baby — which is exactly how they handled the first one.

Congratulations in the comments?

Diwali just got crowded.

Suriya's next is titled Scene, and it opens on 6 November — the same day as Ramayana: Part 1.
He plays a chain-smoking cop credited with 900 arrests. Jithu Madhavan (Romancham, Aavesham) directs his first Tamil film; Sushin Shyam scores; Nazriya Nazim and Naslen co-star.
Ramayana, meanwhile, has Ranbir Kapoor, Yash and Sai Pallavi, with a score by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer.
Diwali falls on 8 November. Both films are betting on the two days before it.

Which ticket are you booking first?

Meghna Gulzar's Daayra is dividing critics.

Kareena Kapoor Khan plays DCP Ajooni Kohli; Prithviraj Sukumaran plays DCP Raman Kumar. Two officers, one case, two very different readings of duty and the law.
Gulzar has said the team looked at several real cases while writing it, rather than one.
Reviews praise the performances and the moral complexity; several flag the pacing. It released on 18 September.

text:
Culture Check: Diwali 2026 is a two-film war. Facts first, our take at the end.

The facts:
· Ramayana: Part 1 — 6 Nov. Nitesh Tiwari directs; Ranbir Kapoor is Ram, Yash is Raavan, Sai Pallavi is Sita. Score by A.R. Rahman and Hans Zimmer. Reported budget ₹4,000 crore across both parts.
· Scene — 6 Nov. Suriya as a cop with 900 arrests, in Jithu Madhavan's first Tamil film. Sushin Shyam scores.
· Diwali falls on 8 November. Both open two days before it.

Our take is on the last slide, and it isn't about who "wins".

2026 · Daayra: DCP Ajooni Kohli, in theatres now.

Why have you not seen Manjummel Boys?

A group of friends from Kochi visits the Guna Caves in Kodaikanal. One of them falls into a 120-foot chasm. It really happened, in 2006.
Soubin Shahir leads; Chidambaram directs.
It grossed about ₹242 crore worldwide — the first Malayalam film past ₹200 crore — and won 10 awards at the Kerala State Film Awards.
Streaming on JioHotstar.

A survival thriller where nobody is a hero until somebody has to be.

Who are you sending this to?
